day_shape: 69 items: Iranian ballistic missiles at Aqaba intercepted by US air defence with Iron Dome fragments over Eilat, renewed strikes on Kuwait and Bahrain, Khamenei message declaring Trump's signature 'worthless', Aoun-Trump White House meeting flagged; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Iran missile attack on Aqaba, Jordan
threads.summary: The IDF said Iran launched four ballistic missiles at Aqaba, with three intercepted by US air defence and a fourth hitting an open area in Jordan. Iron Dome interceptors were fired over Eilat at falling fragments; no sirens sounded and fragments landed in open ground.

threads.label: Iranian strikes on Gulf states
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported sirens in Kuwait and Bahrain following renewed Iranian attacks, with damage to a Kuwaiti power plant and a desalination plant. IRIB circulated footage it said showed the Kuwait power plant fire after the impact.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz, oil and US posture
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post cited a report that Iran exported roughly 70 million barrels worth about $5 billion during a month-long suspension of the US blockade, and said Washington is looking to bypass Hormuz via regional partners while moving refuelling tankers to Ramon and IDF bases. Defa Press said the IRGC Navy reported four ships defying Hormuz control instructions, with two suffering incidents; CENTCOM posted imagery of F-35Bs aboard USS Boxer in the Arabian Sea.

threads.label: Khamenei message and regime unity messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a message declaring the US president's signature 'worthless and invalid' and urged national unity, echoed by parliament speaker Qalibaf and Quds Force commander Qaani pledging loyalty to Mojtaba Khamenei. Defa Press said Chinese media amplified the message; IRIB carried Ansarallah's Al-Nuaimi warning that the US would be the biggest loser in any regional war.

threads.label: Iranian air-defence and homeland incidents
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB said Iranian navy air defences downed a 'Lucas' drone in the south, and reported explosion sounds in Abadan and controlled detonation of unexploded ordnance in eastern Tehran on Monday. Foreign Minister Araghchi was quoted saying Iran's strikes on US bases had transformed the regional security architecture.

threads.label: Lebanon track and Hezbollah
threads.summary: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun was reported travelling to the White House to meet Trump with a Hezbollah disarmament plan, while Tel Aviv University's Eyal Zisser told the Jerusalem Post Hezbollah's weekend attack on the Lebanese Army was a signal it would escalate if threatened. IRIB cited Lebanon's health ministry putting the death toll from Israeli strikes since 2 March at 4,328 killed and 12,227 wounded, and reported an Israeli detonation near Kafr Tebnit.

threads.label: Domestic repression and judiciary
threads.summary: Defa Press announced the execution of two men convicted over the January 'American-Zionist coup' unrest in Isfahan, and the Jerusalem Post reported files opened against 300 Iranians accused of contact with Iran International or Manoto and a 74-lash sentence for singer Anita Papist. Judiciary chief Ejei denied political bias in rulings.
